components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Action CTA — Action Blue fill, restrained height.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 0.5rem; height: 2.25rem; padding: 0.5rem 1rem; border: none; border-radius: 0.525rem; background: #3b82f6; color: #fff; font-family: Lexend, sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 500; cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.15s ease; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: color-mix(in oklab, #3b82f6 90%, transparent); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px color-mix(in oklab, oklch(0.623 0.214 259.815) 50%, transparent); }

components.name: Ghost Button
components.description: Quiet secondary action with accent wash on hover.
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; height: 2.25rem; padding: 0.5rem 1rem; border: none; border-radius: 0.525rem; background: transparent; color: oklch(0.141 0.005 285.823); font-family: Lexend, sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 500; cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.15s ease; } .ds-btn-ghost:hover { background: oklch(0.967 0.001 286.375); } .ds-btn-ghost:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px color-mix(in oklab, oklch(0.623 0.214 259.815) 50%, transparent); }

components.name: Default Input
components.description: Transparent field with hairline border and signal-blue focus ring.
components.css: .ds-input { width: 100%; height: 2.25rem; padding: 0.25rem 0.75rem; border: 1px solid oklch(0.92 0.004 286.32); border-radius: 0.525rem; background: transparent; color: oklch(0.141 0.005 285.823); font-family: Lexend, sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; outline: none; transition: border-color 0.15s ease, box-shadow 0.15s ease; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: oklch(0.552 0.016 285.938); } .ds-input:focus-visible { border-color: oklch(0.623 0.214 259.815); box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px color-mix(in oklab, oklch(0.623 0.214 259.815) 50%, transparent); }

components.name: Contact Underline Field
components.description: Signature contact form field — bottom border only, action-blue focus.
components.css: .ds-input-underline { width: 100%; padding: 0.75rem 0; border: 0; border-bottom: 1px solid color-mix(in oklab, oklch(0.92 0.004 286.32) 80%, transparent); border-radius: 0; background: transparent; color: oklch(0.141 0.005 285.823); font-family: Lexend, sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; outline: none; transition: border-color 0.2s ease; } .ds-input-underline::placeholder { color: color-mix(in oklab, oklch(0.552 0.016 285.938) 70%, transparent); } .ds-input-underline:focus { border-bottom-color: #3b82f6; }

components.name: Default Badge
components.css: .ds-badge { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.25rem; padding: 0.125rem 0.5rem; border-radius: 0.525rem; border: 1px solid transparent; background: oklch(0.623 0.214 259.815); color: oklch(0.97 0.014 254.604); font-family: Lexend, sans-serif; font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 500; }

components.name: Project Card
components.description: Evidence tile with media, category chip, and hover lift.
components.css: .ds-card-project { display: flex; flex-direction: column; overflow: hidden; border: 1px solid color-mix(in oklab, oklch(0.92 0.004 286.32) 60%, transparent); border-radius: 0.65rem; background: oklch(1 0 0); font-family: Lexend, sans-serif; transition: transform 0.3s ease; } .ds-card-project:hover { transform: translateY(-0.25rem); } .ds-card-project__media { aspect-ratio: 16 / 10; background: oklch(0.967 0.001 286.375); } .ds-card-project__body { padding: 1rem; } .ds-card-project__title { margin: 0; font-size: 1rem; font-weight: 500; color: oklch(0.141 0.005 285.823); } .ds-card-project__meta { margin: 0.25rem 0 0; font-size: 0.75rem; color: oklch(0.552 0.016 285.938); }

narrative.overview:
This site is a recruiter-facing brief, not a mood board. Hierarchy is crisp and short: who you are, where you worked, what you shipped, how to reach you. Surfaces stay quiet so live demos and project evidence do the proving. Ornament is scarce; motion is purposeful (typed intro, split-name entrance, soft card hover) rather than decorative noise.

The system is a light/dark shadcn-derived token set with Lexend as the single voice. Primary blue marks actions and focus — never large fields of color. Density is comfortable: max-width 6xl (72rem) containers, generous section padding, and clear scan landmarks.
keyCharacteristics: Single typeface (Lexend) across display through label
Flat tonal layering with glass header; no structural shadow vocabulary
Scarce action blue on CTAs, focus rings, and active accents
Evidence-first project cards with soft hover lift only
Restrained controls: soft radius (~10.4px base), quiet borders

rules.name: The Scarce Signal Rule
rules.body: Action blue appears on primary CTAs, focus, and thin accent marks (e.g. contact rail) — not as large background fields. Its rarity keeps the scan path clear.

rules.name: The Dual-Theme Parity Rule
rules.body: Light and dark share the same roles; dark swaps paper/ink and deepens primary chroma slightly. Do not invent a third palette.

rules.name: The One Voice Rule
rules.body: Lexend is the only loaded face. Do not introduce a second display or serif pairing without an explicit redesign.

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: Surfaces rest flat. Do not add card drop shadows as a default treatment.

dos: Do keep the recruiter scan path short: profile → experience → projects → contact.
Do reserve action blue for CTAs, focus, and thin accent rails.
Do use Lexend exclusively and size for hierarchy.
Do prefer tonal layering and blur over shadow stacks.
Do let project demos and thumbnails carry visual weight.
donts: Don't flood sections with primary blue backgrounds.
Don't introduce a second display font or decorative serif without redesign intent.
Don't default cards to heavy drop shadows.
Don't invent testimonials, metrics, or employers not already on the site.
Don't turn the first viewport into a dashboard of stats — keep the brief clean.
